rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone is entertained by or finds something funny.

example.english: I was amused by this movie.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 siu3

rows.note: Use this when describing an amused-looking person, especially someone smiling.

example.english: They always greet customers with an amused smile.
example.traditional: 佢成日都笑咪咪咁同客人打招呼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 siu3 mai1 mai1 gam2 tung4 haak3 jan4 daa2 ziu1 fu1
